$note: Prices are per 1,000,000 tokens, always in CNY — the app's single money base, so no row carries a currency label. The one automatic conversion happens while entering: a recognised $ screenshot is folded at fx_usd_cny before it lands in the row, and a screenshot with no currency mark at all is entered as CNY untouched. A hand-copied dollar price is yours to convert into the number you type — the app cannot tell $4 from ¥4 by looking at a digit, so there is deliberately no in-row fold that could multiply a CNY price by mistake. fx_usd_cny (1 USD = ? CNY) is yours to fill and is never used in costing, which is why it ships as null instead of a guessed market rate. A row may also carry an optional 'buyout_amount': the one-off CNY you paid for a plan covering that channel. It is never multiplied by usage and never amortised into a per-token price — it is summed into its own overview figure ('买断支出') shown beside, and never added to, the consumption total. Omitting it means 'this row is not a buyout'; writing 0 means 'a plan that cost nothing', and the two are kept visibly apart. Keys are per-channel triples 'source|provider_id|model_id': the same model served through two channels gets two independent prices, never one shared row. Copy the exact key from the Pricing page, which lists every channel zlens sees — a hand-typed key that matches no channel simply prices nothing. Copy this file to pricing.json (gitignored) and edit freely. A channel absent from the table is rendered tokens-only and never priced. cache_write is optional; entries without it simply show zero cache-write cost.
